title: Mobile Automator Workspace Config
description: Schema for .mobile-automator/config.json. Declares the type of every key `mauto config set` knows about. Unknown keys are permitted (additionalProperties: true) so agents can persist project knowledge this schema does not anticipate — the schema types keys, it does not gate them.

stringList.description: A list of strings. `mauto config set` accepts either a JSON array or a comma-separated value and stores a list either way.

nullableString.description: A string, or null when the value is not yet configured.

mode.description: Selected at setup. Configs predating this field are treated as platform-aware.

engine.description: Which mobile-mcp device robot drives the device. `mobilecli` (default) is mobile-mcp's mobilecli robot. `legacy` selects mobile-mcp's legacy robot (MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROBOT=1) — adb/uiautomator on Android, go-ios/WDA on real iOS devices (iOS simulators always use mobilecli). An exported MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROBOT overrides this key. Device ids differ between engines (AVD name vs adb serial), so re-run `mauto devices` after switching. A running session on the other engine is restarted by the next device verb. See #251.

telemetry.description: Anonymous usage telemetry. Off unless `enabled` is literally true. MAUTO_TELEMETRY=0 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 override this and always win; MAUTO_TELEMETRY=1 deliberately does not enable. Run `mauto telemetry status` for the exact field list.

enabled.description: Opt in to anonymous usage telemetry. Default false. Set with `mauto telemetry enable`.

run.description: Optional timings and limits for `mauto run`. Every key is optional and absent by default (the scaffold does not write this block); an absent key keeps the default named below.

poll_ms.description: Milliseconds between looks at the screen while a step waits.

default_timeout_ms.description: How long a wait step waits when its own wait_config names no timeout.

scroll_max_swipes.description: Most swipes a scroll_to_element step makes before it fails.

loading_indicator_labels.description: On-screen labels (text or accessibility label, matched like a target) that mean something is still loading; wait_for_loading_complete waits for all of them to be gone. Empty by default, in which case the step cannot know what to look for and says so.

app.description: Legacy nested shape written by pre-CLI setup. Read by the placeholder resolver.

knowledge.description: Legacy nested shape written by pre-CLI setup. Read by the placeholder resolver.
